notes.title: July Dev Log - Introducing the Dive Valve
notes.notes:
[p]Hey Weavers[i],

[/i]We've been a little quiet recently. The developers have been deep in the coding mines but I snagged some time and had the opportunity to talk with Moonlight Kids, the developers of [i]Echo Weaver[/i], to talk about a new level asset in the game and how the player can interact with it!
[/p][quote][p]We're pretty far along in development on Echo Weaver, so most of your core systems, tools, and level design widgets are done. But recently, we added a new one: the dive valve.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXcAkQJ6ma6Oed5eJhXCajlOuMb13fkHW2JYI95KdmOUPcDgrLimTrNr1wgD17aMN6g3KcJ8EjLRswSM316-FTjU-NNUdGQXi1erGtImMCNU-KM4oKBhwwu74uAPkqQNC5HaTmOo1w?key=5xSNvqTtejIG7LP52bbklg"][/img]                             [i]Dive Valve (Note: asset is FPO and environment is not decorated)[/i][/p][p][/p][p]Most you probably know of "one-way platforms", a staple in platformers. These are platforms that freely allow passage from below, but not freely from above (sometimes not at all, like in Echo Weaver). The dive valve is the inverse. It prohibits passage from below, but permits from above. To use it, the player must perform a "dive" from above to open the hatches.[/p][p][img src="https://lh7-rt.googleusercontent.com/docsz/AD_4nXf4S7joKZJ0OpP87IgJ9aQFhyT07VOKIqPQbd8L_ESVM_-ZKkooJE66Vdy68LSU79WFbjyR9D4E2nxtpXtf7ULqEK70gt-0SbzdETnWxbTJ8As8A2b10oUhLtipa4jpTKVpysm0jw?key=5xSNvqTtejIG7LP52bbklg"][/img][/p][p][i]                                                    PC performing a dive through a Dive Valve[/i][/p][p][/p][p]This is a useful tool for gating in order to keep a player locked in a region until they understand a concept or accomplish some task. In Echo Weaver, we needed a way to teach dive, so we had to lock the player in a region, not with a lock and key, but with a dive valve. The player must learn how to dive in order to progress. We have a few of these in a row to really make sure the player understands the relationship between the dive valve and player movement.[/p][p][/p][p]We've actually been sitting on this idea for some time now, and the biggest reason we pulled the trigger was to finally lock in some of the tutorials and by chance one of the artists had a mockup of, funnily enough, a one-way platform that we thought would be a better fit for the dive valves. In this case, the waiting paid off because we're really happy with the mechanics and visuals of this widget.[/p][/quote][p]
If you are interested in Echo Weaver metroidBRAINia, then consider wishlisting!
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184080/Echo_Weaver/"][/dynamiclink]Moonlight Kids have weekly developer streams in their [u][url="https://discord.com/invite/qSGTDRh"]Discord[/url][/u], and I would strongly recommend joining to get some behind the scenes in the development of [i]Echo Weaver[/i].[/p][p][/p][p]-riv otter[/p]

notes.title: Akupara Games is Publishing Echo Weaver!
notes.notes:
Hey Weavers,

My name is Joseph, and I’m the community manager for Akupara Games and I’m excited to reveal that we’ve partnered with Moonlight Kids to bring [i]Echo Weaver[/i] to our tortoise family of games!

The moment I beat the demo, I knew that [i]Echo Weaver[/i] was something special which many people from the team, including me, have been itching to tell you more about! We could see the quality and passion that Moonlight Kids put into [i]Echo Weaver[/i] and that was something we’re eager to support. 

[previewyoutube=7GbbVO23e3g;full][/previewyoutube]

[i]Echo Weaver[/i] is a time loop metroidBRAINia where time is your currency and secrets are your only upgrades. You are the last Weaver, remnant of a ruined society trapped in a fatal time loop. Uncover their story - and your own - as you explore what remains.

Wishlist [i]Echo Weaver[/i]
https://store.steampowered.com/app/2184080/Echo_Weaver/

I can’t wait to share more information about [i]Echo Weaver[/i] but the first door closes in ten seconds and we have no time to stand around; Get going! 

- Riv otter
